_comment: Does the 2,048-character tool-description cut measured on Claude Code (Q7) hold on other hosts? Probed on Codex CLI, ChatGPT and claude.ai against the `rich` tier (https://europe-west4-mcp-metadata-demo.cloudfunctions.net/mcp): get_building_profile description 7,978 chars, server instructions 2,829 chars. Fingerprints: Claude Code's cut ends '...pre-2008 homes.\n5. La' (char 2,048); the full text ends '...based on warmtebehoefte.'; '5. Large panden' starts at char 2,046, 'CALCULATED vs MEASURED' at ~3,990. Plus a small Codex pilot on three eval questions, rich vs best.

codex-cli.tool_description: NOT in the prompt: 0 chars. MCP tools are deferred (feature tool_search_always_defer_mcp_tools = true). The model gets one `exec` tool (a 24,107-char JS code-mode description) that says nested tools are on `tools.*` and listed in `ALL_TOOLS` as {name, description}. When the model filters ALL_TOOLS and prints an entry, it receives the description UNCUT.

headline: The 2,048-char description cut is a Claude Code number. Codex CLI, ChatGPT (Chat and Work) and claude.ai all deliver the whole 7,978-char description.

Server instructions are the fragile surface elsewhere: ChatGPT Chat cuts them at 512 chars; ChatGPT Work and claude.ai do not deliver them at all (Work puts the app description typed in ChatGPT in their place); Codex prepends them to every tool description.

On Codex, ChatGPT Work and claude.ai (with many connectors) the tool is deferred: 0 chars in the prompt until the model searches (Codex filters ALL_TOOLS by keyword over name + description; claude.ai uses tool_search). In the Codex pilot the model found and read the configured tool in 20/21 runs and printed its whole description before calling; the 21st picked the account-level ChatGPT copy of the same server.

Codex pilot (gpt-5.6-sol, n=3): best 9/9; rich 7/9 — benchmark-trap 1/3, the same hedged EP-1-vs-70 verdict Q19 scored as a fail. Same direction as Claude Code, now on a host where rich's text is not cut.
caveats: Self-report probes (ChatGPT, claude.ai) rest on the model quoting verbatim, checked against the wire fingerprints. The ChatGPT 512 cut replicated 2/2; claude.ai 2/2. Codex was measured on the request itself.
One ChatGPT Work run. Codex pilot n=3 per cell, one model; a pilot, not a registered question.
ChatGPT model under the default 'Gemiddeld' effort; host behaviour may change without notice (Codex's defer flag is marked 'removed'/true in 0.154).
claude.ai was measured with ~17 connectors enabled, which is why its tools were deferred. With one connector the tools may sit in the prompt; whether they are cut there is unmeasured.
